53800.commentary: (JAa) yam'ettha vakkhāmī'ti yaṃ te ahaṃ etesu kāraṇesu etaṃ kāraṇaṃ vakkhāmi.

examples.text: bahūni ṭhānāni vicintayitvā, yam'ettha vakkhāmi tadeva saccaṃ, maññāmi te brāhmaṇa sattubhastaṃ, ajānato kaṇhasappo paviṭṭho.
yam'pi taṃ diṭṭhaṃ sutaṃ mutaṃ viññātaṃ pattaṃ pariyesitaṃ, anuvicaritaṃ manasā tam'pi etaṃ mama, eso'ham'asmi, eso me attā'ti samanupassati

attani ca, bhikkhave, attaniye ca saccato thetato anupalabbhamāne, yam'pi taṃ diṭṭhiṭṭhānaṃ, so loko so attā, so pecca bhavissāmi nicco dhuvo sassato avipariṇāmadhammo, sassatisamaṃ tath'eva ṭhassāmī'ti, nan'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, kevalo paripūro bāladhammo'ti?

53802.meaning1: which one desires; what one wants
53802.commentary: (DNa) yampicchan'ti yena'pi dhammena alabbhaneyyavatthuṃ icchanto na labhati, taṃ alabbhaneyya vatthumhi icchanaṃ dukkhaṃ.

examples.text: jāti'pi dukkhā, jarā'pi dukkhā, byādhi'pi dukkho, maraṇam'pi dukkhaṃ, soka-parideva-dukkha-domanass'upāyāsā'pi dukkhā, yam'p'icchaṃ na labhati tam'pi dukkhaṃ, saṃkhittena pañc'upādānakkhandhā dukkhā.
appiyehi sampayogo dukkho, piyehi vippayogo dukkho, yam'p'icchaṃ na labhati tam'pi dukkhaṃ

idhalokam'pi nissāya jhāyati, paralokam'pi nissāya jhāyati, yam'p'idaṃ diṭṭhaṃ sutaṃ mutaṃ viññātaṃ pattaṃ pariyesitaṃ anuvicaritaṃ manasā, tam'pi nissāya jhāyati. evaṃ kho, sandha, purisakhaḷuṅkajhāyitaṃ hoti.
yam'p'idaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkham'asukhaṃ vā tam'pi suññaṃ attena vā attaniyena vā.

53804.meaning1: whatever indeed for him; whatever indeed of that

examples.text: yam'pi'ssa taṃ, bhikkhave, khayasmiṃ khayeññāṇaṃ, tam'pi saupanisaṃ vadāmi, no anupanisaṃ. kā ca, bhikkhave, khayeñāṇassa upanisā? vimuttī'ti'ssa vacanīyaṃ.
tassa rūpaṃ… vedanaṃ… saññaṃ… saṅkhāre… viññāṇaṃ samanvesato yāvatā viññāṇassa gati, yam'pi'ssa taṃ hoti ahan'ti vā maman'ti vā asmī'ti vā tam'pi tassa na hotī'ti.

53805.grammar: pron, masc & nt abl sg of ya

examples.text: yamhā dhammaṃ vijāneyya, sammāsambuddhadesitaṃ, sakkaccaṃ taṃ namasseyya, aggihuttaṃ'va brāhmaṇo.

53806.grammar: pron, masc & nt loc sg of ya
53806.meaning1: in whoever; in whom; in which

examples.text: n'atthi jhānaṃ apaññassa, paññā n'atthi ajhāyato, yamhi jhānañ'ca paññā ca, sa ve nibbānasantike.
yamhī na māyā vasatī na māno, yo vītalobho amamo nirāso, panuṇṇakodho abhinibbut'atto, so brāhmaṇo so samaṇo sa bhikkhū'ti.

na kho, gahapati, arahati ariyasāvako yasakāmo yasaṃ āyācituṃ vā abhinandituṃ vā yasassa vā'pi hetu. yasakāmena, gahapati, ariyasāvakena yasasaṃvattanikā paṭipadā paṭipajjitabbā. yasasaṃvattanikā hi'ssa paṭipadā paṭipannā yasapaṭilābhāya saṃvattati.

byāruddhe'ti yobbaññakāmā sattā jarāya paṭiviruddhā, ārogyakāmā sattā byādhinā paṭiviruddhā, jīvitukāmā sattā maraṇena paṭiviruddhā, lābhakāmā sattā alābhena paṭiviruddhā, yasakāmā sattā ayasena paṭiviruddhā, pasaṃsakāmā sattā nindāya paṭiviruddhā, sukhakāmā sattā dukkhena paṭiviruddhā āhatā paccāhatā āghātitā paccāghātitāti, osāne tv'eva byāruddhe.

53808.meaning1: peak of fame; summit of prestige; highest renown
53808.commentary: (MNa) yasaggan'ti yasassa aggaṃ. saṅgho hi yāva na yas'aggapatto hoti, na tāva yasaṃ paṭicca āsavaṭṭhānīyā dhammā uppajjanti. patte pana uppajjanti, atha satthā sikkhāpadaṃ paññapeti surāmerayapāne pācittiyan'ti (pāci. 327). idañ'hi yasaggapatte saṅghe sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ.

examples.text: taṇhacchidassa buddhassa, vītadhūmassa anupalittassa, āhuneyyassa yakkhassa, uttamapuggalassa atulassa, mahato yas'aggapattassa, bhagavato tassa sāvako'ham'asmī'ti.
na tāva, bhaddāli, idh'ekacce āsavaṭṭhānīyā dhammā saṅghe pātubhavanti yāva na saṅgho lābh'aggaṃ patto hoti, yas'aggaṃ patto hoti, bāhusaccaṃ patto hoti, rattaññutaṃ patto hoti.

53809.meaning1: reached the summit of prestige; attained the peak of fame; highly renowned

examples.text: taṇhacchidassa buddhassa, vītadhūmassa anupalittassa, āhuneyyassa yakkhassa, uttamapuggalassa atulassa, mahato yas'aggapattassa, bhagavato tassa sāvako'ham'asmī'ti.

53810.meaning1: reached the peak of fame; attained the pinnacle of renown
53810.commentary: (DNa) lābh'aggappatto'ti lābh'aggaṃ patto, aggalābhaṃ patto'ti vuttaṃ hoti. yas'aggappatto'ti yas'aggaṃ aggaparivāraṃ patto.

examples.text: so imesaṃ sattannaṃ vatapadānaṃ samādānahetu lābh'aggappatto c'eva yas'aggappatto ca vajjigāme.
so iminā yasapañcamena dhammena samannāgato yassaṃ yassaṃ disāyaṃ viharati, sakasmiṃ'y'eva vijite viharati. taṃ kissa hetu?
yasakāmena, gahapati, ariyasāvakena yasasaṃvattanikā paṭipadā paṭipajjitabbā. yasasaṃvattanikā hi'ssa paṭipadā paṭipannā yasapaṭilābhāya saṃvattati. so lābhī hoti yasassa dibbassa vā mānusassa vā.

yato naṃ samannesamāno evaṃ jānāti, dīgharattaṃ samāpanno ayam'āyasmā imaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ, n'āyam'āyasmā ittarasamāpanno'ti, tato naṃ uttariṃ samannesati, ñatt'ajjhāpanno ayam'āyasmā bhikkhu yasappatto, saṃvijjant'assa idh'ekacce ādīnavā'ti?

53817.meaning2: greatness of fame or wealth, high position

examples.text: dhi'r'atthu taṃ dhanalābhaṃ, yasalābhañ'ca brāhmaṇa, yā vutti vinipātena, adhammacaraṇena vā.

53819.meaning1: fame; reputation; renown; honour; glory; prestige
53819.notes: Mano-group nouns, while neuter in Sanskrit, are considered to be masculine by classical Pāḷi grammars such as Saddanīti. The example given is mano anicco, mano dukkho'ti. Counter-examples are amoghaṃ tapo and paramaṃ tapo.

examples.text: uṭṭhānavato satīmato, sucikammassa nisammakārino, saññatassa dhammajīvino, appamattassa yaso'bhivaḍḍhati.
sace bhavaṃ soṇadaṇḍo samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamissati, bhoto soṇadaṇḍassa yaso hāyissati, samaṇassa gotamassa yaso abhivaḍḍhissati.

53820.meaning1: leading to fame; conducive to renown

examples.text: ime dve piṇḍapātā samasamaphalā samavipākā, ativiya aññehi piṇḍapātehi mahapphalatarā ca mah'ānisaṃsatarā ca. āyusaṃvattanikaṃ āyasmatā cundena kammāraputtena kammaṃ upacitaṃ, vaṇṇasaṃvattanikaṃ āyasmatā cundena kammāraputtena kammaṃ upacitaṃ, sukhasaṃvattanikaṃ āyasmatā cundena kammāraputtena kammaṃ upacitaṃ, yasasaṃvattanikaṃ āyasmatā cundena kammāraputtena kammaṃ upacitaṃ, saggasaṃvattanikaṃ āyasmatā cundena kammāraputtena kammaṃ upacitaṃ, ādhipateyyasaṃvattanikaṃ āyasmatā cundena kammāraputtena kammaṃ upacitanti. cundassa, ānanda, kammāraputtassa evaṃ vippaṭisāro paṭivinetabbo'ti.

53821.meaning1: fame and longevity; reputation and long life
53821.meaning2: fame and longevity; reputation and long life

examples.text: te aññe atirocanti, vaṇṇena yasasāyunā, sāvakā bhūripaññassa, vises'ūpagatā idha.

53823.meaning1: he is famous; he is renowned

examples.text: purimañ'ca disaṃ rājā, dhataraṭṭho pasāsati, gandhabbānaṃ adhipati, mahārājā yasassiso.

53824.commentary: (SNa) yasassinan'ti parivārasaṅkhātena yasena sampannānaṃ. (SNa) app'icchā santuṭṭhā app'icchatāya vattham'pi na nivāsentī'ti evaṃ samuggato yaso etesaṃ atthī'ti yasassino

examples.text: atha kho sabhiyo paribbājako tassā devatāya santike te pañhe uggahetvā ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā saṅghino gaṇino gaṇ'ācariyā ñātā yasassino titthakarā sādhusammatā bahujanassa… te upasaṅkamitvā te pañhe pucchati.
ayaṃ loko paro loko, brahmaloko sadevako, diṭṭhiṃ te n'ābhijānāti, gotamassa yasassino.

53825.meaning1: name of a privately awakened Buddha

examples.text: ariṭṭho upariṭṭho tagarasikhī yasassī, sudassano piyadassī ca susambuddho, gandhāro piṇḍolo upāsabho ca, nīto tatho sutavā bhāvit'atto.
puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, sapatto sapattassa evaṃ icchati, aho vat'āyaṃ na yasavā assā'ti! taṃ kissa hetu? na, bhikkhave, sapatto sapattassa yasavatāya nandati.
puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, sapatto sapattassa evaṃ icchati, aho vat'āyaṃ na yasavā assā'ti! taṃ kissa hetu? na, bhikkhave, sapatto sapattassa yasavatāya nandati.
pahūtavitt'ūpakaraṇo, rājā hoti patāpavā, iddhimā yasavā hoti, jambumaṇḍassa issaro.
tatra, bhikkhave, ko viseso ko adhippayāso [adhippāyo, adhippāyaso adhi + pa + yasu + ṇa + sī = adhippayāso] kiṃ nānākaraṇaṃ paṇḍitassa bālenā'ti?
catūhi kho, gahapati, dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako gihisāmīcipaṭipadaṃ paṭipanno hoti yasopaṭilābhiniṃ saggasaṃvattanikaṃ. katamehi catūhi?

53835.meaning1: loss of fame; decline in renown

examples.text: appamattikā esā, bhikkhave, parihāni yadidaṃ yasoparihāni. etaṃ patikiṭṭhaṃ, bhikkhave, parihānīnaṃ yadidaṃ paññāparihānī'ti.

53836.meaning1: obtained by fame; gained through fame

examples.text: yasoladdhā kho pan'amhākaṃ bhogā.

53837.meaning1: growth of fame; increase in renown

examples.text: appamattikā esā, bhikkhave, vuddhi yadidaṃ yasovuddhi. etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, vuddhīnaṃ yadidaṃ paññāvuddhi.

53838.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of ya

examples.text: yasmā ca kho, bhikkhave, sakkā akusalaṃ pajahituṃ tasm'āhaṃ evaṃ vadāmi, akusalaṃ, bhikkhave, pajahathā'ti.
yasmā ca kho, kassapa, aññatr'eva imāya mattāya aññatra iminā tapopakkamena sāmaññaṃ vā hoti brahmaññaṃ vā dukkaraṃ sudukkaraṃ, tasmā etaṃ kallaṃ vacanāya, dukkaraṃ sāmaññaṃ dukkaraṃ brahmaññan'ti.

yasmā ca kho ahaṃ, bhikkhave, saṅghāṭikam'pi idh'ekaccaṃ passāmi abhijjhāluṃ byāpannacittaṃ kodhanaṃ upanāhiṃ makkhiṃ paḷāsiṃ issukiṃ macchariṃ saṭhaṃ māyāviṃ pāp'icchaṃ micchādiṭṭhikaṃ, tasmā na saṅghāṭikassa saṅghāṭidhāraṇamattena sāmaññaṃ vadāmi.
yasmā ca kho, kassapa, aññatr'eva imāya mattāya aññatra iminā tapopakkamena sāmaññaṃ vā hoti brahmaññaṃ vā dukkaraṃ sudukkaraṃ, tasmā etaṃ kallaṃ vacanāya, dukkaraṃ sāmaññaṃ dukkaraṃ brahmaññan'ti.
yasmiṃ, bhikkhave, samaye līnaṃ cittaṃ hoti, akālo tasmiṃ samaye passaddhisambojjh'aṅgassa bhāvanāya, akālo samādhisambojjh'aṅgassa bhāvanāya, akālo upekkhāsambojjh'aṅgassa bhāvanāya.
yasmiṃ, mahānāma, samaye ariyasāvako sīlaṃ anussarati n'ev'assa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti.

53841.grammar: pron, masc & nt loc sg of ya
53841.meaning1: in whoever; in whichever; at whichever

examples.text: yasmiṃ c'assā padese ṭhitāya evam'assa, yaṃnūn'āhaṃ agatapubbañ'c'eva disaṃ gaccheyyaṃ, akhāditapubbāni ca tiṇāni khādeyyaṃ, apītapubbāni ca pānīyāni piveyyan'ti tañ'ca padesaṃ na sotthinā paccāgaccheyya.
yasmiṃ kāmā na vasanti, taṇhā yassa na vijjati, kathaṃkathā ca yo tiṇṇo, vimokkho tassa n'āparo.

53842.grammar: pron, masc & nt loc sg of ya

examples.text: ekañ'hi saccaṃ na dutīyam'atthi, yasmiṃ pajā no vivade pajānaṃ, nānā te saccāni sayaṃ thunanti, tasmā na ekaṃ samaṇā vadanti.
evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, yassa kassaci bhikkhuno kāyagatāsati abhāvitā abahulīkatā, taṃ cakkhu āviñchati manāpiyesu rūpesu, amanāpiyā rūpā paṭikūlā honti
evam'eva kho, rāhula, yassa kassaci sampajānamusāvāde n'atthi lajjā, n'āhaṃ tassa kiñci pāpaṃ akaraṇīyan'ti vadāmi. tasmā't'iha te, rāhula, hassā'pi na musā bhaṇissāmī'ti.
yassa yassa ca abhiññā sacchikaraṇīyassa dhammassa cittaṃ abhininnāmeti abhiññā sacchikiriyāya tatra tatr'eva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati satiāyatane.

53845.grammar: pron, masc & nt dat sg of ya
53845.meaning1: to whom; for whom; for whoever; for whatever; for whichever

examples.text: yassa ete dhanā atthi, itthiyā purisassa vā, adaliddo'ti taṃ āhu, amoghaṃ tassa jīvitaṃ.
yassa nissayatā n'atthi, ñatvā dhammaṃ anissito, bhavāya vibhavāya vā, taṇhā yassa na vijjati.

53846.grammar: pron, masc & nt gen sg of ya

examples.text: yassa pāpaṃ kataṃ kammaṃ, kusalena pidhīyati, so'maṃ lokaṃ pabhāseti, abbhā mutto'va candimā.
sabb'eva tuṇhībhūtā pañjalikā pallaṅkena nisīdanti, yassa'dāni devassa pallaṅkaṃ icchissati brahmā sanaṅkumāro, tassa devassa pallaṅke nisīdissatī'ti.
na brāhmaṇassa pahareyya, n'āssa muñcetha brāhmaṇo, dhī brāhmaṇassa hantāraṃ, tato dhī yassa muñcati.

53848.grammar: masc, comp, dat sg of yassattha
53848.meaning1: for which purpose; for which reason

examples.text: atha kho so bhikkhu eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahit'atto viharanto nacirass'eva, yass'atthāya kulaputtā samma'd'eva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭh'eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.

tumhe'pi, bhikkhave, nacirass'eva, yass'atthāya kulaputtā samma'd'eva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭh'eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharissatha.

53849.meaning1: now for whatever; now of whichever
53849.commentary: (DNa) yassa'dāni tvan'ti yassa idāni tvaṃ mahārāja gamanassa kālaṃ maññasi jānāsi, tassa kālaṃ tvam'eva jānāsī'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: evam'etaṃ, bhagavā, evam'etaṃ, sugata. yassa'dāni, bhante, bhagavā kālaṃ maññatī'ti. atha kho bhagavā uṭṭhāy'āsanā pakkāmi.
sabb'eva tuṇhībhūtā pañjalikā pallaṅkena nisīdanti, yassa'dāni devassa pallaṅkaṃ icchissati brahmā sanaṅkumāro, tassa devassa pallaṅke nisīdissatī'ti.

53850.grammar: idiom, pron + adv + masc + pr, impers
53850.meaning1: it is time to do as one wishes; one is free to go
53850.meaningLit: now one thinks it is time for whatever

examples.text: yassa'dāni, māṇava, brahm'āyu brāhmaṇo kālaṃ maññatī'ti.
evam'etaṃ, bhagavā, evam'etaṃ, sugata. yassa'dāni, bhante, bhagavā kālaṃ maññatī'ti. atha kho bhagavā uṭṭhāy'āsanā pakkāmi.

53851.meaning1: for whom they may be; whose could be

examples.text: yass'assu lunāni bandhanāni, ajjhattaṃ bahiddhā ca saṅgamūlaṃ, sabbasaṅgamūlabandhanā pamutto, ājāniyo tādi pavuccate tathattā'ti.

53852.grammar: pron, fem loc sg of ya

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, rañño bhaddo ass'ājānīyo ubhato sujāto hoti, mātito ca pitito ca. yassaṃ disāyaṃ aññe'pi bhaddā ass'ājānīyā jāyanti, tassaṃ disāyaṃ jāto hoti.
api my'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, parisā suññā viya khāyati parinibbutesu sāriputtamoggallānesu. asuññā me, bhikkhave, parisā hoti, anapekkhā tassaṃ disāyaṃ hoti, yassaṃ disāyaṃ sāriputtamoggallānā viharanti.

53854.grammar: pron, fem dat sg of ya

examples.text: yassā yassā ca pilandhanavikatiyā ākaṅkhati, yadi paṭṭikāya, yadi kuṇḍalāya, yadi gīveyyake, yadi suvaṇṇamālāya, tañ'c'assa atthaṃ anubhoti.

53855.grammar: pron, fem gen sg of ya

examples.text: tam'enaṃ evaṃ vadeyyuṃ, esā, kho, bhante, vīṇā nāma, yassā eso saddo evaṃrajanīyo evaṃkamanīyo evaṃmadanīyo evaṃmucchanīyo evaṃbandhanīyo'ti.
so evaṃ vadeyya, ayaṃ vā so, āvuso, pāsādo, yass'āhaṃ ārohaṇāya nisseṇiṃ karomi, tass'eva pāsādassa heṭṭhā'ti.

53857.commentary: (MNa) suṇohi yass'āhaṃ sāvako'ti tassa guṇe suṇāhī'ti bhagavato vaṇṇe vattuṃ āraddho.

examples.text: evaṃ vutte, upāli gahapati uṭṭhāy'āsanā ek'aṃsaṃ uttar'āsaṅgaṃ karitvā yena bhagavā ten'añjaliṃ paṇāmetvā nigaṇṭhaṃ nāṭaputtaṃ etadavoca, tena hi, bhante, suṇohi yass'āhaṃ sāvako'ti
saṅkhāya lokasmiṃ paro'parāni, yass'iñjitaṃ n'atthi kuhiñci loke, santo vidhūmo anīgho nirāso, atāri so jātijaranti brūmī'ti.
yass'eva bhīto na dadāti maccharī, tadev'ādadato bhayaṃ, jighacchā ca pipāsā ca, yassa bhāyati maccharī, tam'eva bālaṃ phusati, asmiṃ loke paramhi ca.

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, yavakalāpī cātumahāpathe nikkhittā assa. atha cha purisā āgaccheyyuṃ byābhaṅgihatthā. te yavakalāpiṃ chahi byābhaṅgīhi haneyyuṃ. evañ'hi sā, bhikkhave, yavakalāpī suhatā assa chahi byābhaṅgīhi haññamānā.

53863.meaning1: bundle of barley; sheaf of barley

navame doṇiyā baddho'ti yavasassadoṇiyā samīpe baddho.

53868.meaning1: barley husk spike; bristle of barley
53868.commentary: (ANa) sālisūkan'ti sāliphalassa sūkaṃ. yavasūke'pi es'eva nayo. (ANt) kaṇasadiso sāliphalassa tuṇḍe uppajjanakavālo sālisūkaṃ, tathā yavasūkaṃ.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, sālisūkaṃ vā yavasūkaṃ vā micchāpaṇihitaṃ hatthena vā pādena vā akkantaṃ hatthaṃ vā pādaṃ vā bhindissati [bhecchati], lohitaṃ vā uppādessatī'ti, n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati. taṃ kissa hetu?

53870.commentary: (JAa) khemaṃ yahiṃ tattha arī udīrito'ti yasmiṃ udakapiṭṭhe khemabhāvo nibbhayabhāvo, tasmiṃ attapaccatthiko sapatto uṭṭhito.

examples.text: na kho, āvuso, bhagavā sukhaṃ'y'eva vedanaṃ sandhāya sukhasmiṃ paññapeti, api ca, āvuso, yattha yattha sukhaṃ upalabbhati yahiṃ yahiṃ taṃ taṃ tathāgato sukhasmiṃ paññapetī'ti.
khemaṃ yahiṃ tattha arī udīrito, dakassa majjhe jalate ghat'āsano, na ajja vāso mahiyā mahīruhe, disā bhajavho saraṇ'ājja no bhayan'ti.

53871.synonym: yā kāci, ye keci, yo koci

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, gaṇḍo anekavassagaṇiko. tass'assu gaṇḍassa nava vaṇamukhāni nava abhedanamukhāni. tato yaṃ kiñci pagghareyya, asuci'y'eva pagghareyya, duggandhaṃ'y'eva pagghareyya, jegucchiyaṃ'y'eva pagghareyya.
yaṃ kiñci sampajānāsi, uddhaṃ adho tiriyañ'cā'pi majjhe, etesu nandiñ'ca nivesanañ'ca, panujja viññāṇaṃ bhave na tiṭṭhe.

53872.grammar: pron, nt nom sg of ya

examples.text: seyyathā'pi nāma suddhaṃ vatthaṃ apagatakāḷakaṃ samma'd'eva rajanaṃ paṭiggaṇheyya, evam'eva yasassa kulaputtassa tasmiṃ'y'eva āsane virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi, yaṃ kiñci samudayadhammaṃ, sabbaṃ taṃ nirodhadhamman'ti.
iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ idam'etaṃ paṭicca vuttan'ti.

53873.grammar: pron, masc fem & nt acc sg of ya

examples.text: eko ahaṃ sakka mahantam'oghaṃ, anissito no visahāmi tārituṃ, ārammaṇaṃ brūhi samantacakkhu, yaṃ nissito ogham'imaṃ tareyyaṃ.
idh'eva suddhi iti vādayanti, n'āññesu dhammesu visuddhim'āhu, yaṃ nissitā tattha subhaṃ vadānā, paccekasaccesu puthū niviṭṭhā.

53874.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of ya

examples.text: yaṃ kho, brāhmaṇa, ārabbhadhātuyā sati ārabbhavanto sattā paññāyanti, ayaṃ sattānaṃ attakāro ayaṃ parakāro.
avijjā'ti dukkhe aññāṇaṃ… yaṃ evarūpaṃ aññāṇaṃ adassanaṃ anabhisamayo ananubodho asambodho appaṭivedho asaṃgāhanā apariyogāhanā asamapekkhanā apaccavekkhaṇā
māgadhake paricārake ārabbha aṭṭhiṃ katvā manasikatvā sabbaṃ cetasā samannāharitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi, gatiṃ nesaṃ jānissāmi abhisamparāyaṃ, yaṃgatikā te bhavanto yaṃabhisamparāyā'ti.
sā sabbā'pi idha labbhati. tāsu yaṃkañci pathaviṃ ayaṃ puthujjano pathavito sañjānāti, pathavī'ti sañjānāti, pathavībhāgena sañjānāti, lokavohāraṃ gahetvā saññāvipallāsena sañjānāti pathavī'ti.

53878.grammar: pron, comp, nt nom sg of yaṃkaci

examples.text: sabbaṃ dhammaṃ pariññāya yaṃkiñci vedanaṃ vediyati sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkham'asukhaṃ vā.
yaṃkiñci sithilaṃ kammaṃ, saṅkiliṭṭhañ'ca yaṃ vataṃ, saṅkassaraṃ brahmacariyaṃ, na taṃ hoti mahapphalan'ti
anuvattakā'ti yaṃdiṭṭhiko so hoti yaṃkhantiko yaṃruciko te'pi taṃdiṭṭhikā honti taṃkhantikā taṃrucikā.

53880.meaning1: having whichever destination; with whichever destiny

examples.text: gatiṃ nesaṃ jānissāmi abhisamparāyaṃ, yaṃgatikā te bhavanto yaṃabhisamparāyā'ti.

puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, sekho bhikkhu pañc'indriyāni pajānāti, saddh'indriyaṃ, vīriy'indriyaṃ, sat'indriyaṃ, samādh'indriyaṃ, paññ'indriyaṃ, yaṃgatikāni yaṃparamāni yaṃphalāni yaṃpariyosānāni. na h'eva kho kāyena phusitvā viharati, paññāya ca ativijjha passati.

53881.meaning1: having whichever view; holding whichever opinion

examples.text: anuvattakā'ti yaṃdiṭṭhiko so hoti yaṃkhantiko yaṃruciko te'pi taṃdiṭṭhikā honti taṃkhantikā taṃrucikā.
mayaṃ kho bhoto reṇussa sahāyā piyā manāpā appaṭikūlā, yaṃsukho bhavaṃ taṃsukhā mayaṃ, yaṃdukkho bhavaṃ taṃdukkhā mayaṃ.

53884.commentary: (SNa) yaṃnidān'āvuso, jātī'ti, āvuso, ayaṃ jāti nāma yaṃpaccayā, tassa paccayassa khayā khīṇasmiṃ jātiyā paccaye jātisaṅkhātaṃ phalaṃ khīṇan'ti viditaṃ.

examples.text: evaṃ puṭṭho'haṃ, bhante, evaṃ byākareyyaṃ, yaṃnidānā, āvuso, jāti, tassa nidānassa khayā khīṇasmiṃ khīṇ'āmhī'ti viditaṃ.

53885.meaning1: dependent on which; relying on which

examples.text: yaṃnūna mayaṃ imaṃ ekaputtakaṃ piyaṃ manāpaṃ vadhitvā vallūrañ'ca soṇḍikañ'ca karitvā puttamaṃsāni khādantā evaṃ taṃ kantār'āvasesaṃ nitthareyyāma, mā sabb'eva tayo vinassimhā'ti
atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ etadahosi, atippago kho tāva sāvatthiyaṃ piṇḍāya carituṃ. yaṃnūna mayaṃ yena aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ ārāmo ten'upasaṅkameyyāmā'ti.

53887.meaning1: what if I were to for him; let me to him; I shall (explain) for him

examples.text: atha kho bhagavato etadahosi, mamañ'ca khv'āyaṃ kulaputto uddissa pabbajito. yaṃnūn'ass'āhaṃ dhammaṃ deseyyan'ti.

53888.meaning1: what if I were to; let me; I shall; perhaps I

examples.text: tassā evam'assa, yaṃnūn'āhaṃ agatapubbañ'c'eva disaṃ gaccheyyaṃ, akhāditapubbāni ca tiṇāni khādeyyaṃ, apītapubbāni ca pānīyāni piveyyan'ti.
yaṃnūn'āhaṃ tiṇakaṭṭhasākhāpalāsaṃ saṃkaḍḍhitvā, kullaṃ bandhitvā, taṃ kullaṃ nissāya hatthehi ca pādehi ca vāyamamāno sotthinā pāraṃ uttareyyan'ti.

53889.grammar: ind, adv, comp, abl sg of yaṃpaccaya
53889.meaning1: due to which; on account of which; because of which

examples.text: sāmaṃ vā taṃ, ānanda, kāyasaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti, yaṃpaccayā-assa taṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ. pare vā taṃ, ānanda, kāyasaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharonti, yaṃpaccayā

53890.meaning1: on account of which for him; because of which for him; due to which for him

examples.text: sāmaṃ vā taṃ, ānanda, kāyasaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti, yaṃpaccay'āssa taṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ. pare vā taṃ, ānanda, kāyasaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharonti, yaṃpaccay'āssa taṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ.

53891.meaning1: having whatever peak; having with whichever apex

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, sekho bhikkhu pañc'indriyāni pajānāti, saddh'indriyaṃ, vīriy'indriyaṃ, sat'indriyaṃ, samādh'indriyaṃ, paññ'indriyaṃ, yaṃgatikāni yaṃparamāni yaṃphalāni yaṃpariyosānāni. na h'eva kho kāyena phusitvā viharati, paññāya ca ativijjha passati.

53892.meaning1: having whatever end; with whichever conclusion

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, sekho bhikkhu pañc'indriyāni pajānāti, saddh'indriyaṃ, vīriy'indriyaṃ, sat'indriyaṃ, samādh'indriyaṃ, paññ'indriyaṃ, yaṃgatikāni yaṃparamāni yaṃphalāni yaṃpariyosānāni. na h'eva kho kāyena phusitvā viharati, paññāya ca ativijjha passati.

53893.meaning1: having whatever fruit; with whichever result

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, sekho bhikkhu pañc'indriyāni pajānāti, saddh'indriyaṃ, vīriy'indriyaṃ, sat'indriyaṃ, samādh'indriyaṃ, paññ'indriyaṃ, yaṃgatikāni yaṃparamāni yaṃphalāni yaṃpariyosānāni. na h'eva kho kāyena phusitvā viharati, paññāya ca ativijjha passati.

53894.meaning1: how frequently; whatever usually; what habitually
53894.commentary: (SNa) yaṃbahulaṃ yaṃbahulan'ti iminā nigaṇṭho attanā'va attano vādaṃ bhindati.

examples.text: evaṃ kho, bhante, nigaṇṭho nāṭaputto sāvakānaṃ dhammaṃ desetī'ti. yaṃbahulaṃ yaṃbahulañ'ca, gāmaṇi, viharati, tena tena nīyati, evaṃ sante na koci āpāyiko nerayiko bhavissati, yathā nigaṇṭhassa nāṭaputtassa vacanaṃ.

53895.meaning1: with whatever preferences; with whichever inclinations

examples.text: anuvattakā'ti yaṃdiṭṭhiko so hoti yaṃkhantiko yaṃruciko te'pi taṃdiṭṭhikā honti taṃkhantikā taṃrucikā.
taṃ, bhikkhave, attavād'upādānaṃ upādiyetha, yaṃsa attavād'upādānaṃ upādiyato na uppajjeyyuṃ soka-parideva-dukkha-domanass'upāyāsā.
passatha no tumhe, bhikkhave, taṃ diṭṭhinissayaṃ yaṃsa diṭṭhinissayaṃ nissayato na uppajjeyyuṃ soka-parideva-dukkha-domanass'upāyāsā'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.
mayaṃ kho bhoto reṇussa sahāyā piyā manāpā appaṭikūlā, yaṃsukho bhavaṃ taṃsukhā mayaṃ, yaṃdukkho bhavaṃ taṃdukkhā mayaṃ.
cattāro'pi mahārājāno yathāsakesu āsanesu nisīdiṃsu, obhāsam'etaṃ ñassāma yaṃvipāko bhavissati, sacchikatvāva naṃ gamissāmā'ti.

53899.grammar: pron, fem nom sg & pl of ya

examples.text: dummedhehi pasaṃsā ca, viññūhi garahā ca yā, garahāva seyyo viññūhi, yaṃ ce bālappasaṃsanā.
yā c'eva kho pana ajjhattikā pathavīdhātu yā ca bāhirā pathavīdhātu, pathavīdhātu'r'ev'esā.
